With only $35 and single houses on Park Place and Boardwalk, I'm weighing whether to trade for $200 to build on the dark blues, but that risks giving player 3 the red monopoly with their $679 cash to build fast. Trying to grab Illinois myself for the red set isn't viable since I'd have no cash left to build anyway. I'm considering instead selling off my railroads for cash and a short line swap to free up capital.

Still, giving p3 the reds with $479 cash lets them build about 3 houses, which feels too risky—I think I'll push back and counter their offer at $300 instead of settling lower.
